meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: English common law and French civil law traditions, with customary law recognition
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: None in force providing comprehensive investment protection to International Companies; regional participation includes the Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA) and the Interim Economic Partnership Agreement between Vanuatu and the European Union (provisionally applied).

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], as amended; Proceeds of Crime Act [Cap. 170], as amended; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [Cap. 196], as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Regulations (Statutory Instruments); Financial Intelligence Centre Act and applicable VFSC/Financial Intelligence Unit directives.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the VFSC AML/CFT consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, HM Treasury sanctions list, and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit designated persons list. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) trigger enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Official Registry Portal (VFSC Company Registry Name Reservation System)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All International Company names must be expressed in Latin script. Non-English and non-French names must be accompanied by a certified English translation or transliteration. Names must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered name. The name suffix must be 'Limited' or 'Ltd' unless VFSC consent is obtained.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may file a written appeal with the VFSC Registry within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice. The appeal must state the proposed name, the exact reasons for requesting reconsideration, and evidence distinguishing the name from the conflicting registered name or sensitive token list. VFSC must determine the appeal within 21 working days. Further review may be sought through the Financial Services Commission Tribunal and thereafter by judicial review to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual-only office is not accepted for a licensed cold storage logistics operator. The statutory registered office may be the registered agent's physical address in Vanuatu, but the operational refrigerated warehousing premises must constitute a separately identifiable physical site where commercial substance is demonstrable. If no physical cold storage facility is established in Vanuatu, the entity must be able to prove economic substance and the physical location of its principal warehouse in accordance with prevailing economic substance expectations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated unannounced on-site inspection probability: 35% per annum, increasing to 50% if the entity is selected for VFSC risk-based desk review or if sanctions/PEP flags arise.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], especially ss. 3-12 (Incorporation and constitution), s. 15 (Registered office), ss. 24-27 (Shares and capital); International Companies (Amendment) Act 2001; Business Licence Act [Cap. 260] for operational licensing.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission - International Companies and Trusts Registry, Port Vila, Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, together with Form 1 (Incorporation Application) and Form 2 (Consent of Registered Agent), filed by a licensed registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is imposed. The memorandum may provide for authorized capital declared by the incorporator, commonly USD 10,000, without an escrow or pre-funding requirement. Shares may be issued for cash or other consideration as permitted by the Board.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company be formed as a Vanuatu International Company with authorized share capital of US$10,000; that the subscriber named in the Articles subscribes for the shares opposite the subscriber's name and that payment is deemed satisfied as set out in the incorporation documents; that the registered office at the registered agent's address in Port Vila be adopted; that the registered agent be appointed; that the directors be appointed; that Mr/Ms ________ be appointed Managing Director and Mr/Ms ________ be appointed Secretary; and that such officers be authorised to execute all filings, open a corporate bank account and execute lease and utility documents for the cold-storage warehouse.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry and Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority, in coordination with Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the operating Business Licence for refrigerated warehousing. Submit the incorporation certificate, warehouse lease, operational plan, environmental registration certificate, and tax registration application. The licence fee is assessed based on the applicant's estimate of monthly revenue and is paid before the licence is issued.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement or title deed of the cold-storage warehouse
Cold-storage operational plan including refrigeration and monitoring systems
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the licence objection is raised, submit the additional floor plan and sanitation certificate from the Municipal Authority within 14 days, or appeal in writing to the Commissioner of Industry within 21 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry and Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration tier (Category B) - environmental registration is required; a full EIA Report is triggered only if the cold-storage facility exceeds 10,000 cubic metres capacity or uses refrigerant systems above the threshold set by the Ozone Layer Protection Regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge to the municipal sewer or watercourse must comply with Vanuatu Water Resources Management Act [Cap. 271] and the National Water Quality Standards; refrigerants must be controlled to avoid release, with a leakage rate below 0.1% of charge per year; use of CFCs and HCFCs is prohibited; diesel generators must meet the DEPC emission limits for particulate matter and NOx.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire Services Department; structural load inspection and engineering clearance from the Public Works Department; occupational safety and health clearance from the Department of Labour confirming personnel safety, cold-environment risk mitigation, and emergency response readiness.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury / Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); the tax administration portal is operated by the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC) under the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management. Official registration and filing portal: https://www.vrctax.gov.vu/ and corporate registry portal: https://www.vfsc.vu/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing in Vanuatu must first incorporate or register as an International Company (IC) through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) and obtain a Certificate of Incorporation. Following incorporation, the IC must apply for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) via the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC) online portal or in-person at the VRC office, submitting the Certificate of Incorporation, certified passport copies of directors/shareholders, proof of registered agent appointment in Vanuatu, a registered office address, and the completed TIN application form. Approval of the TIN is generally issued within 3 to 5 business days. Where the IC engages in taxable supplies under the Value Added Tax (VAT) regime, a separate VAT registration number must be obtained under the VAT Act [Cap. 363] before making taxable supplies, with the VAT registration threshold and application procedures administered by the VRC. Foreign entities not maintaining a physical presence may still obtain a TIN solely for income tax administration purposes; however, no domestic income tax is imposed on qualifying International Companies. The statutory fee schedule and annual renewal requirements are published by VFSC and VRC, and the IC must complete an annual license renewal with VFSC regardless of tax-exempt status.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] and the VAT Act, an International Company may elect to be treated as tax-exempt only if it does not conduct domestic trading activity in Vanuatu. No check-the-box election exists because Vanuatu does not impose income tax on International Companies; however, an IC may voluntarily register for VAT under Section 7 of the VAT Act if the VRC determines that the entity is carrying on a taxable activity in Vanuatu. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available in Vanuatu. A hybrid entity election may arise under foreign jurisdictions' rules only where Vanuatu law classifies the IC as opaque for foreign tax purposes; Vanuatu generally issues a Certificate of Tax Residence or Certificate of Non-Residence only upon application, and the fiscal status of an IC is determined by its place of incorporation and compliance with the International Companies Act. For VAT purposes, a person may elect to register for VAT where turnover is below the threshold solely at the discretion of the Commissioner of Revenue, and such election is binding for at least 24 months.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 11 of 2010 as consolidated; administered by Vanuatu Revenue and Customs. Goods and services tax is not a separate system; a 12.5% VAT applies to taxable supplies made in Vanuatu. Sales and use tax does not exist in Vanuatu.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 (Vanuatu vatu) annual taxable turnover, as prescribed under the VAT Act and VRC regulations. A person is required to register for VAT if the value of taxable supplies exceeds or is expected to exceed VUV 5,000,000 in any 12-month period. Registration is mandatory once the threshold is met; voluntary registration is available below the threshold upon application and is subject to the Commissioner's discretion. International Companies engaged solely in export of goods or services may register for VAT to recover input VAT on exported supplies, but input VAT recovery is available only for taxable activities and complies with the zero-rating provisions.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not currently mandate a fully automated real-time electronic invoicing or fiscal clearance system for all VAT taxpayers. The VRC operates a manual and semi-electronic filing system through its portal, with e-filing available for VAT returns and customs declarations using the Asycuda World system for customs import/export clearances. For taxable supplies, VAT invoices must be issued within 28 days of the supply and must contain prescribed particulars, including the word 'tax invoice', supplier's name, address and VAT registration number, recipient details, description, quantity, taxable value, VAT amount, and date. Digital stamping is not required in Vanuatu. A real-time clearance mechanism applies only to customs export and import declarations through Asycuda, with electronic filing and automated risk assessment; export declarations must be lodged through the Asycuda portal and cleared before goods are exported. API integration with VRC systems is not currently mandated but is permitted for high-volume filers upon VRC approval.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Section 10 of the VAT Act, a supply of goods is zero-rated where the goods are exported by the supplier from Vanuatu within a prescribed time frame (generally 28 days from the time of supply or as otherwise approved by the Commissioner) and the supplier obtains and retains evidence of export. A supply of services, including cold chain logistics and refrigerated storage services for perishable pharmaceuticals, is zero-rated when the services are supplied for consumption outside Vanuatu or are directly connected with movable goods that are exported, provided the recipient is not in Vanuatu and the services are of a type that the Commissioner determines to be exported. Refrigerated logistics services physically performed in Vanuatu are not zero-rated if the recipient of the service is a Vanuatu resident and the service is enjoyed in Vanuatu. The zero-rating of ancillary transport and handling services requires that the service is performed directly in respect of goods being exported and is separately identified on the customs declaration. Input tax on costs attributable to zero-rated exports may be recovered via a VAT refund, subject to the documentary substantiation requirements, provided the VAT is not blocked by input tax restriction rules under Section 17 of the VAT Act.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Asycuda format, with unique declaration number and customs officer clearance)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill showing the exporter as the consignor and a foreign consignee outside Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate or foreign currency credit evidence from a bank licensed in Vanuatu showing the export proceeds received from outside Vanuatu
Commercial Invoice referencing the VAT invoice and zero-rated supply narrative
Packing List matching the export cargo quantities
Insurance certificate or transport document evidencing movement from Vanuatu to an overseas destination
VAT tax invoice marked 'Zero-rated export' and containing the supplier's VAT registration number
Copy of the registered agent's declaration of no domestic market supply, where applicable for an International Company
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Where a VAT-registered person zero-rates an export without proper documentation or where the goods/services are not actually exported, the VRC may assess VAT at 12.5% on the full taxable value, with interest accruing at a rate published by the Commissioner. Fraudulent zero-rating claims attract penalties under the VAT Act including an amount equal to twice the tax sought to be avoided, imprisonment for up to 10 years for knowingly supplying false information or for forgery, and a monetary fine not exceeding VUV 1,000,000 for each false declaration. The VRC may also invoke the Tax Administration Act provisions for failure to register, failure to preserve records, and failure to file returns, with fines ranging from VUV 5,000 to VUV 500,000 and up to 2 years' imprisonment. A refund or credit may be clawed back (with interest computed from the date of refund) where the VRC subsequently establishes that the export documentation is false, forged, or non-compliant. In addition, under the International Companies Act, an International Company that breaches its offshore-only condition may forfeit its tax-exempt status and become liable to tax, if any, under the Income Tax Act (currently nil), but would be denied the protection of the IC regime and may be struck off, with director liability arising for any unpaid VAT.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), operating under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap 125] and the Exchange Control Act [Cap 58] as the delegated exchange-control authority of the Minister of Finance; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) regulates the International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], but holds no mandate over currency, FX, or clearing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) trades under a trade-weighted managed float administered by the RBV. Vanuatu has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations, so current-account payments (warehousing fees, refrigeration logistics invoices, insurance, freight, and operating disbursements) are freely convertible without prior approval. Capital-account transactions (share capital subscriptions, shareholder loans, loan repayments above VUV 5 million) require standard filing via Form EX1/EX2 with an authorized dealer, but no prior consent is required for a non-resident International Company. Profit remittance is unrestricted for the Tax-Exempt IC: zero withholding tax, zero capital gains tax, and no obligation to convert VUV receipts into VUV. The IC may maintain External Accounts with authorized dealers and may hold USD, AUD, NZD, or EUR balances offshore free of exchange control, provided the underlying commercial documentation substantiates the flows and no speculative FX dealing is undertaken.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender ratio or mandatory conversion timeline to VUV applies to export receipts. Resident exporters must repatriate proceeds to Vanuatu within 180 days of shipment and submit declaration forms to the RBV through an authorized dealer, but may retain proceeds in an approved foreign-currency account. A non-resident International Company (VU_IC) is exempt from surrender: receivables from cold-storage and temperature-controlled warehousing services may be credited directly to an External Account or a foreign-currency account at an authorized dealer, or to an offshore USD/AUD account, without conversion, as long as the invoices and service contracts precisely match the beneficiary name and reference the scope 'ISIC 5210 Refrigerated Logistics Warehousing'.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (multi-currency USD/AUD/NZD/VUV) and Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account (USD/EUR/AUD/VUV) and Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account (domestic VUV focus, limited USD clearing)
External Account (non-resident IC treasury) and Capital Escrow Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for mainstream offshore EMIs (Airwallex, Wise Business, Currencycloud, Payoneer) because Vanuatu is on the FATF grey list and the International Company structure triggers automated KYC rejection engines. Medium for specialized neo-banks and EMI issuers whose compliance teams accept grey-listed jurisdictions after enhanced due diligence, a physical-substance dossier (cold-storage lease deed, utility and payroll invoices, staff contracts), and a board resolution explaining the treasury function. Legal constraints: any EMI must be appropriately licensed in its home jurisdiction; RBV AML/CFT directives prohibit the IC from using an unlicensed EMI for settling Vanuatu-resident invoices; USD-denominated ACH and Fedwire clearing requires a correspondency in the United States or a partner bank with direct US membership.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, at least one director or ultimate beneficial owner must appear physically for the initial meeting at Bred Bank and NBV; ANZ and BSP permit remote video-KYC onboarding for a Low-Risk Standard account of this type, provided photo identification is notarized and the VFSC-registered agent attests the certified copies of the constitutional documents. Recommended protocol: one physical signing visit to Port Vila or an equivalent in-office meeting with an authorized dealer officer in the director's residence jurisdiction, together with a notarized Board Resolution authorizing account opening, the signatory matrix, and the source-of-funds statement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident International Company with tax-exempt status perceived as an untaxed offshore shell
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VU_IC Certificate of Incorporation; VFSC extract of directors and shareholders; certified Memorandum and Articles of Association; VFSC Tax Exemption Certificate; registered agent's Certificate of Good Standing; Board Resolution describing the active accounting, invoicing, and treasury operations; legal opinion from licensed Vanuatu counsel confirming non-resident status and the absence of domestic tax liability.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FATF grey-list designation of Vanuatu attracting adverse media and correspondent-bank scrutiny
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced Due Diligence questionnaire; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds report for the subscribing UBO; group structure chart and ultimate beneficial ownership declaration; proof of commercial substance (cold-storage facility lease, utility invoices, payroll, three-year business plan); sanctions and PEP screening statements; board commitment to provide quarterly transaction reports and counterparty tax identification numbers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pharmaceutical-sector payments moving through intermediaries, trusts, or intra-group invoicing hubs
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Underlying warehousing service agreements with pharmaceutical manufacturers; chain-of-title documentation; Good Distribution Practice and ISO 14001/ISO 23412 certificates of the cold-storage operator; invoice and proof-of-delivery register; transaction-flow diagrams and explicit risk-committee pre-approval from the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large initial capital escrow funding from a non-bank financing vehicle or holding company
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Share subscription agreement; audited financial statements and bank statements of the funding entity showing the origin of funds; notarized passports of the UBOs; declaration that no cryptocurrency, bearer instruments, or anonymous payment channels were used; confirmed board resolution of the funding entity and independent legal verification of the lenders' regulatory standing.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing: (1) open an Operational or External Account with an authorized dealer; (2) the parent or shareholder dispatches an SWIFT MT103 quoting the IC's precise legal name and the reference 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION / SHARE SUBSCRIPTION - VU_IC'; (3) include the ISO 20022 structured purpose code 'CAPL' or 'TRAD' where the bank's schema requires a charge code; (4) the bank credits the Capital Escrow Account after verifying the Board Resolution, the funding entity's bank statement, and a completed source-of-funds questionnaire. Inward VUV remittances above VUV 5 million are declared by the authorized dealer on Form EX1/EX2; no RBV prior approval is required for a non-resident IC capital account. Verification artifacts: MT103 confirmation, SWIFT message reference, IC bank credit advice, and the escrow account statement clearly tagged 'capital contribution'.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rails: (a) SWIFT MT103 for non-documentary trade payments (freight, storage infrastructure, energy, insurance, lease distributions) using ISO 2022 structured remittance and purpose code 'TRADE/SUPP'; (b) Commercial Letters of Credit under UCP 600, issued via MT700/MT710 by ANZ, BSP, or Bred for high-value refrigeration and construction equipment; (c) Bank Wire (Fedwire/CHIPS) for USD-only settlements where the IC holds a USD correspondency at a US partner bank; (d) ACH Direct for recurring low-value US-originated payments and lease recoveries from a US-based pharmaceutical tenant. VUV-denominated transfers clear through Vanuatu's national payment system (non-RTGS, typically same-day or next-day); AUD/NZD payments clear through the Australian and New Zealand exchange settlement systems in one to two business days; USD transactions settle in one to three business days through the correspondent chain.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forward contracts with authorized dealers (tenor up to 12 months; renewable upon evidence of underlying trade or loan exposure and RBV-approved documentation)

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on the VUV transacted with non-resident market makers (offshore Sydney and Auckland desks) referencing the RBV published rate, used solely to hedge VUV-denominated rent, energy, or utility obligations

Cross-currency swaps (USD/VUV or AUD/VUV) for long-term capital-equipment financing, permitted on a case-by-case basis where an identifiable asset or liability exists and no speculative position is created
Natural hedging through multi-currency operational accounts and FX deposit sweeps (USD/AUD/NZD) to minimize the need for derived derivative instruments

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of an International Company (International Companies Act, Cap. 222, s. 74) together with the Annual Government Renewal Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry, submitted through the licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of incorporation; the annual return covers the immediately preceding 12-month period ending on the anniversary date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a prescribed penalty under the IC Act; if the annual return and fee remain outstanding for more than three months after the due date, the Registrar may administratively strike the company off the International Companies Register and dissolve it, with struck-off assets subject to statutory vesting in the Government of Vanuatu.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit — National Beneficial Ownership Registry, filed through the licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed each year on or before the anniversary of incorporation; any share transfer or change in ultimate beneficial ownership must additionally be reported within 14 calendar days of the event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or wilful misstatement is a strict-liability offence carrying fines up to VUV 1,000,000 (approximately USD 8,200) and imprisonment for up to 12 months; repeated non-compliance also exposes the International Company to VFSC strike-off and the Registered Agent to licence suspension or revocation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Annual Re-Confirmation (statutory particulars)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Furnished concurrently with the Annual Return, on or before each anniversary of incorporation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Maintaining an ineffective registered office or an unlicensed/incapable Registered Agent is a continuing offence under the IC Act; VFSC may impose monetary penalties and, after due notice, strike the company off the International Companies Register.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. A Vanuatu International Company is statutorily exempt from independent audit regardless of revenue, total assets, or shareholder count. An audit becomes mandatory only if the company's articles of association so require, a lender, insurer, or investor contractually imposes it, or VFSC directs a special examination in an enforcement or insolvency context.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Section 76 of the International Companies Act (Cap. 222) requires the company to keep adequate records of all sums received and paid, sales, purchases, assets, and liabilities so as to reflect its financial position with reasonable accuracy. No prescribed statutory GAAP applies; financial statements produced for third-party stakeholders are ordinarily prepared in accordance with IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed Registered Agent must maintain the beneficial ownership register and file an annual UBO Confirmation Statement on each anniversary of incorporation. Every share transfer must be executed in accordance with the articles of association, recorded in the Register of Members, and the ownership database updated within 14 days of the event. The annual confirmation certifies the current ultimate natural-person owners (or senior managing officials where no individual owner exists); any failure to disclose a transfer is a strict-liability offence punishable by fine and imprisonment.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 700 – 1,200 per annum for a Vanuatu licensed Registered Agent and Registered Office service
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – 5,000 per engagement where a voluntary certified audit is commissioned; not a statutory cost

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax at the national level; an International Company is statutorily exempt under the International Companies Act, Cap. 231.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero effective tax rate on all Vanuatu-sourced and foreign-sourced income. The International Company is exempt from taxes on income, profits, distributions, dividends, capital gains, and share transfers. No withholding tax is imposed on dividends, interest, royalties, or management fees paid or received by the IC. No capital duty applies; stamp duty on IC instruments is nominal. The only recurring charges are the annual VFSC government fee (scheduled by authorised share capital) and, where a domestic Business Licence is held, the turnover-based Business Licence fee. No statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions exist because the headline rate is already nil.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Nil corporate income tax return. Vanuatu prescribes no CIT form and maintains no income tax e-filing portal. The mandatory annual lodgement is the VFSC Annual Return of an International Company, submitted electronically via the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, accompanied by the annual government fee and the beneficial ownership confirmation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: VFSC Annual Return and annual fee: due within 30 days of the anniversary of incorporation. Economic Substance Return, where applicable: due within 12 months after the close of the financial year, with the registered agent processing deadline normally set at 6 months after the financial year-end. Business Licence renewal: applied for by 30 June for the licence year commencing 1 July.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name, International Company number, date of incorporation, registered office, and licensed registered agent details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Port Vila registered agent address as the official address; the non-resident operating address of the cold storage business may be shown only as a business activity address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part B – Share capital and shareholders
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, share classes, full legal names, addresses, and shareholding percentages of all shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the ultimate non-resident individuals or holding entities. Bearer shares are prohibited and any legacy bearer instruments must be eliminated and delivered to the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, nationalities, residential addresses, and passport identification of all directors, the company secretary, and senior officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted. At least one natural-person director is strongly recommended to reduce AML and ESR scrutiny.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of the principal business activity, geographic markets served, and confirmation that no domestic Vanuatu business is being transacted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe the activity as refrigerated logistics warehousing of perishable pharmaceuticals operated wholly outside Vanuatu. Do not claim a Vanuatu-based warehouse or Vanuatu-resident customers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of every natural-person beneficial owner, the ownership chain, and the source of funds used to capitalise the IC, filed under the Companies and Trust Service Providers Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Every non-resident UBO must be disclosed. Nominee shareholdings and nominee directorships must be identified as nominee arrangements in the accompanying declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of whether the IC carries on a relevant activity under the Economic Substance Act, with details of income, employees, premises, expenditure, and management location in Vanuatu if declared relevant.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a cold storage operator serving only third-party, unrelated customers, state 'No relevant activity'. If the IC provides logistics or distribution services to a related party, state that the activity is a distribution and service centre business and complete the full substance schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Abbreviated balance sheet and profit or loss data used by VFSC for risk assessment; audited financial statements are not required unless ESR obligations or the registered agent's risk policies demand them.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: File consolidated figures in VUV or USD and attach a note that the cold storage assets are situated outside Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent certification that customer due diligence, risk assessment, and source-of-funds documentation are complete for the entity and all beneficial owners.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the standard risk classification for a licensed cold-chain logistics operator and identify the ACH Direct and Bank Wire payment rails used by the business.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the VFSC Annual Return attracts escalating late fees (typically VUV 25,000 per month under the VFSC fee policy); persistent default leads to strike-off and deregistration. False declarations in the return constitute a criminal offence punishable by fine of up to VUV 1,000,000 and imprisonment, in addition to administrative cancellation of the IC. Failure to file the Economic Substance Return, where required, attracts penalties of up to VUV 10,000,000 and director disqualification. Late Business Licence renewal adds a 25% surcharge and suspends lawful operation of any licensed domestic activity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return (Vanuatu ESR). Electronically prepared by the registered agent and submitted to the VFSC through the agent's secure portal; no direct taxpayer portal exists.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months of the financial year-end; the registered agent normally requires final data 6 months after year-end to meet the VFSC administrative cut-off.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of the relevant activity, if any: banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, intellectual property, or distribution and service centre.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select 'None' when the IC only provides third-party cold storage. Select 'Distribution and service centre' only where services or goods are supplied to a related party and income is derived from related-party transactions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income by category, related-party income, and jurisdictions in which the counterparties are resident.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State that all warehouse service revenue arises from commercial contracts with non-resident, non-related pharmaceutical shippers; no intra-group revenue is declared.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of full-time employees, physical premises, annual expenditure in Vanuatu, and location of board meetings and strategic decision-making.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an IC with no Vanuatu operational presence, show zero employees and zero local expenditure and confirm board meetings held outside Vanuatu, consistent with a non-relevant third-party service activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification by the directors of accuracy and confirmation that the economic substance position has been reviewed by the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The declaration must be signed by at least one director and the registered agent must verify the data against its compliance file.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing or filing of materially false information in the ESR Return exposes the IC to a fine of up to VUV 10,000,000, public listing on the VFSC non-compliance register, and strike-off. Repeat non-compliance leads to mandatory director disqualification and criminal prosecution of the responsible officers.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Business Licence Application and Annual Renewal Return (Vanuatu Business Licence Act). Processed by the Vanuatu Department of Finance and the Municipal Councils, normally through a physical or agent-assisted lodgement; the licence fee is turnover-based.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Renewal applications and fee payments are due by 30 June for the licence period 1 July to 30 June; new applications are processed within 14 business days of submission.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Classification of the business under the Business Licence schedule; cold storage and logistics services generally fall under the general trading/services category.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Inapplicable to a pure offshore IC that does not operate facilities in Vanuatu; if a Vanuatu administrative office is maintained, obtain a general services licence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of expected annual gross turnover in Vanuatu, used to compute the licence fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an offshore IC, declare VUV nil turnover from Vanuatu sources; all warehousing turnover is attributable to foreign operations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical business address within Vanuatu where the licensed activity is conducted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the registered agent's address only if no operational facility exists in Vanuatu; owning or leasing a Vanuatu cold storage facility would contradict the IC's offshore character and require a full licence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Operation without a valid Business Licence is an offence carrying fines per day of unlicensed trading, a 25% late-renewal surcharge, court injunctions prohibiting continued operation, and, for an IC, a direction from VFSC to cease domestic activities or face strike-off.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax. Dividends paid by an International Company to any shareholder, whether resident or non-resident, are exempt from all Vanuatu taxes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has almost no comprehensive double taxation agreements in force; the limited historical arrangements concern only shipping and air transport income and are not applicable to cold-chain warehousing revenue. Treaty relief is therefore structurally unnecessary for outbound dividends because domestic law applies a blanket 0% rate. Where an inbound investor's home jurisdiction requires proof of Vanuatu tax residence to claim a foreign tax credit or treaty benefit in that other jurisdiction, the VFSC can issue a Certificate of Residence (Tax Residency Certificate) upon application through the registered agent; the certificate confirms that the IC is incorporated in Vanuatu and is tax-resident under the laws of Vanuatu, and is accepted by foreign tax authorities as administrative evidence of residence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax rate: 0% for IP royalties, licence fees, debt interest, and management or technical service fees paid by a Vanuatu International Company to non-residents. Because Vanuatu has no withholding tax legislation, no treaty-reduced rate exists to invoke and no application form must be filed before payment.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — Vanuatu has no domestic transfer pricing legislation and prescribes no Local File or Master File thresholds in VUV. The ESR regime nevertheless requires contemporaneous substance records for any entity carrying on a relevant activity. For prudence, an IC engaged in related-party cold-chain logistics should prepare Master File documentation where group turnover exceeds EUR 50 million equivalent and a Local File with benchmarking study where annual related-party service revenue exceeds VUV 20 million (approximately USD 170,000) or intra-group cost recharges exceed VUV 10 million (approximately USD 85,000).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The Vanuatu Economic Substance Act (Act No. 22 of 2018, as amended by the Economic Substance (Amendment) Act 2019) and the Economic Substance Regulations 2019 require any Vanuatu-resident entity carrying on a relevant activity to demonstrate adequate economic presence in Vanuatu: a physical office, full-time employees proportionate to the income, local management and decision-making, sufficient local expenditure, and board meetings held in Vanuatu. A third-party cold storage business serving unrelated pharmaceutical shippers is not a listed relevant activity; however, if the IC provides warehousing or distribution services to related parties within a multinational group, the activity falls within 'distribution and service centre business' and becomes subject to the full substance test. An IC that merely holds the equity of a foreign warehouse-owning subsidiary is classified as a pure equity holding company, a relevant activity subject to a reduced substance standard satisfied through Companies Act compliance, filing of accounts, and BO reporting.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unauthorised Domestic Business in Vanuatu / Breach of International Company Foreign-Operations Mandate
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC leases or operates a refrigerated warehouse inside Vanuatu, employs Vanuatu residents to handle stored goods, invoices Vanuatu-based customers, or otherwise carries on domestic trading without a Business Licence, despite the statutory restriction confining an International Company to business conducted outside Vanuatu and to permitted ancillary activities only.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offence against the International Companies Act: the IC is liable to a fine of up to VUV 1,000,000; VFSC may refuse renewal, apply for court-ordered winding-up, or strike the company off the register. The Business Licence fee becomes retroactively payable with a 25% penalty surcharge, and the domestic business is subject to immediate closure orders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly authorised domestic trading are jointly and severally liable for the company's monetary penalties, may be disqualified from managing any Vanuatu entity for up to 10 years, and are subject to criminal prosecution carrying imprisonment of up to 2 years. Civil restitution to affected counterparties may be ordered by the Supreme Court of Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Offshore Sham Structure Sheltering Foreign Operating Income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A non-resident beneficial owner records the true operating revenue of a foreign cold storage business in the Vanuatu IC while management, invoicing, and bank accounts remain in a high-tax jurisdiction, using the IC as a shell to evade foreign corporate income tax, VAT, or customs duties, with no commercial substance or non-resident economic rationale in Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu has no income tax to apply, but the VFSC and Vanuatu authorities cooperate through exchange-of-information agreements. Foreign revenue authorities applying CFC and GAAR rules will reallocate the income, impose tax, interest, and penalties of up to 200% of the avoided tax, and may blacklist top-up invoices issued by the IC. Under the Proceeds of Crime Act, fraudulent evasion of a foreign tax debt can be prosecuted as an indictable offence where the unpaid foreign liability is treated as property obtained through criminal conduct.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed false invoices, back-dated contracts, or certified sham board minutes can be held personally liable for the foreign tax liabilities under piercing doctrines, subjected to travel bans by the foreign revenue authority where the debt exceeds approximately USD 50,000, and prosecuted in the foreign jurisdiction with extradition risk through Vanuatu mutual assistance channels.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Failure of Economic Substance or Pure Equity Holding SPV Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC files nil-activity returns while in fact it owns cold storage assets and earns rental or warehousing income from those assets, or performs related-party logistics services with no employees, no Vanuatu office, no local board meetings, and no local expenditure, and fails to submit the ESR Return or the required substance schedules.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Economic Substance Act, the VFSC may impose administrative penalties of up to VUV 10,000,000 per serious breach, publish the IC's name on the non-compliance list, and apply to court for strike-off. The IC's foreign counterparties may recharacterise the entity as fiscally transparent, collapsing the intended tax benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly liable for the VUV 10,000,000 penalty, and repeat violations trigger automatic disqualification as directors of any Vanuatu company for 5 years and imprisonment of up to 2 years on conviction. Creditors may bring civil claims against directors for losses caused by false solvency or substance declarations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The registered agent receives false UBO forms; nominee directors conceal the principal; the IC receives ACH or Bank Wire transfers from unknown third parties without source-of-funds documentation; or the cold storage facility is used for pharmaceuticals of disputed lawful provenance without adequate customer due diligence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Companies and Trust Service Providers Act and Vanuatu's Anti-Money Laundering Regulations, the IC and its registered agent face fines of up to VUV 5,000,000 per breach, suspension or disqualification of the agent, and mandatory disclosure of suspicious transactions to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit. The IC's registration may be suspended and its bank accounts frozen.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who conceal beneficial ownership face personal fines of up to VUV 2,000,000 and imprisonment of up to 2 years. The FIU, through the Public Prosecutor, may obtain civil forfeiture of warehouse assets shown to be instrumentalities of crime and may seek preventive travel bans against directors pending investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering and Sanctions Evasion Through the Cold Chain
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC's refrigerated logistics capacity is used to tranship counterfeit or diverted pharmaceuticals; inflated invoices are issued between related companies to shift value; or proceeds of predicate offences such as drug trafficking, healthcare fraud, or sanctions evasion are routed through the IC's bank accounts and paid onward to shell suppliers in high-risk jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Proceeds of Crime Act (Act No. 28 of 2002, as amended), money laundering is a serious offence punishable by a fine of up to VUV 100,000,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 15 years. The court may confiscate the IC's bank balances, receivables, and the foreign warehouse assets legally owned by the IC, and may order the winding-up of the IC in the public interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners convicted of money laundering are subject to imprisonment of up to 15 years, confiscation orders against personal assets, and disqualification from holding any directorial role in Vanuatu for life. Mutual legal assistance processes permit the execution of foreign travel bans and extradition requests against the individuals involved.
